name: model-mover
desc: Free, open-source model library manager for Windows — scan drives, dedupe by hash, move verified, share via junctions. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **Whole-drive model scan** — finds .gguf, .safetensors and .ckpt piles across every folder and drive
✅ **Hash dedupe** — identical copies matched by content hash, not filename, with the best copy kept
✅ **Verified moves** — copy, checksum, then remove the source only after the bytes match
✅ **Library junction** — one real models folder shared with LM Studio and llama.cpp via a Windows junction
✅ **Space report** — per-drive totals and stale model detection for the cleanup that actually frees space
✅ **Restore point notes** — every operation logged with a plain-text undo trail
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Feature | **model-mover** | Manual Explorer moves | Generic dupe finders | Library tools |
| Model file awareness | **Yes** | Manual | None | Partial
| Verified move with hash | **Yes** | No | No | No
| Junction sharing for apps | **Yes** | Manual cmd | No | No |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | N/A | Varies | Varies
faqQ: models fill my drive — how to dedupe and move GGUF files safely?
faqA: The same 20 GB model usually exists three times under different names, and Explorer moves fail next to multi-GB files. model-mover hashes every copy, moves with verification and can share one library across apps with a junction. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, with an undo log for every action.
s1: Dark library (#121417, emerald #10B981): drive map with model counts per folder, duplicate group expanded showing two identical GGUFs and kept-copy badge.
s2: Move dialog: source and destination paths, verify-after-copy toggle on, progress with hash comparison line, estimated time chip reading 4 minutes.
s3: Space report: per-drive usage bars, stale models list with last-opened dates, junction status card reading three apps share one folder.
